sections.chapter_title: Serial peripheral interface / integrated interchip sound (SPI/I2S)
sections.text_helper: Section 27.9.5 "SPI CRC polynomial register (SPIx_CRCPR)" in chapter 27 (Serial peripheral interface / integrated interchip sound (SPI/I2S)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 882.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x10
Reset value: 0x0007
Bits 15:0 CRCPOLY[15:0]: CRC polynomial register
This register contains the polynomial for the CRC calculation.
The CRC polynomial (0x0007) is the reset value of this register. Another polynomial can be
configured as required.
Note: The polynomial value should be odd only. No even value is supported.
